reply.description: The only text shown to the user.

affinity_user.description: Affinity toward the local user, initially 20. 0 is distant, 50 is familiar, 100 is deeply close. Change only for meaningful relational interactions; ordinary messages need no increase. Keep unchanged when no relevant interaction occurs. This range is not a mechanical per-turn transition limit.

mood.description: A short description of the persona's present mood, initially calm; not a durable memory archive.
